mode_review_correction: Original bundle TestMode defaults to bundle zero, but the existing wrapper already installs a choice prefix. The remaining issues are warning-only installation, missing-simulator and invalid-index fallbacks, synchronization and cleanup; unconditional first-bundle play was not established.

repair.changed_behavior: Replace the single method-local TestMode.IsOn call with false after checking exact original IL hashes; preserve game-owned reward constructors, population, pools and RNG. Global TestMode remains on. Initialization completion is recorded after hook installation succeeds.

findings.rationale: The original native TestMode branch uses preset relics. V11 now restores the normal branch with exact IL guards; eight generation/population cases compare original-normal, legacy-test and repaired-test rewards and complete RNG/pool state. Shared stubs/initialization do not prove shipped pickup, curse or nested reward parity.

The original native TestMode branch uses preset potions. V11 restores normal generated rewards with exact IL guards; generation/population and full RNG/pool state match the original-normal reference in the bounded native panel. Shipped pickup, capacity, skip/cancel and nested hooks remain unqualified.

The normal undiscovered alternative-act preference is skipped in test mode. A fully unlocked content policy does not specify discovered acts. Freeze the progress/discovery contract and compare initial act choices and RNG advancement.

The original native TestMode branch selects the first bundle. The existing v10/v11 LocPatches.BundleScreenPrefix already presents pending bundles when the simulator binding exists; do not infer unconditional first-bundle play. Installation catches errors as warnings, missing simulator binding falls back to bundle zero, and DoSelectBundle falls back on an invalid index. Verify actual installation, legal nonfirst choices, invalid/stale rejection, cleanup and synchronization before qualification.

Native selector-stack cleanup is conditional on test mode being off. Interrupted selections and repeated resets need a bound clean-state test; wrapper scope disposal alone is not proof that all native stacks reset.

Test mode uses a test selector or selects rewards automatically. The v10 wrapper installs its reward selector in both start and load paths. This is a declared control seam that needs multi-reward, capacity and cancellation coverage rather than assuming the branch harmless.

Test mode applies damage to the enemy list directly; the normal path schedules damage per visual-hit callback. Death and on-damage ordering need a differential with multiple enemies; batching cannot be declared presentation-only.

A non-null test generator replaces native rest-option generation. Assert it remains unset in production collection and across resets. Existing finite rest fixtures do not establish all hook/option coverage.

Test mode allows a fallback mock RNG when no run is attached. Ensure gameplay models use the active run and player RNGs; model-preview use is separate from seeded gameplay. No fallback reachability claim follows static reading.

Original test-mode branch skips price RNG. The current v9/v10 wrapper restores this exact branch and the eight-case v2 shop panel verifies scoped price/effect agreement. This is a known scoped mitigation, not a new unfixed price regression.
